# Tysma | Lems

Tysma | Lems is an international tax advisory firm in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.
The firm advises globally mobile professionals, maritime professionals, international businesses and private clients on international tax and social security matters.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://www.tysmalems.com/
- Approach: https://www.tysmalems.com/approach/
- Journal: https://www.tysmalems.com/journal/
- Contact: https://www.tysmalems.com/contact/

## Journal Categories

- International Tax: https://www.tysmalems.com/journal/category/international-tax/
- Maritime: https://www.tysmalems.com/journal/category/maritime/
- Global Mobility: https://www.tysmalems.com/journal/category/global-mobility/
- Personal Business: https://www.tysmalems.com/journal/category/personal-business/
- Perspectives: https://www.tysmalems.com/journal/category/perspectives/

## Editorial Focus

The Journal contains thoughts, observations and perspectives on international lives.
Core topics include international tax, maritime tax matters, global mobility, cross-border workers, expatriates, private clients, entrepreneurs, investors, succession, social security and internationally mobile families.

## Crawl Policy

Public pages and published Journal articles are intended to be crawlable by search engines and AI search crawlers.
CMS and editorial desk pages should not be indexed.
